changelog:
Initial release of opensource-llm-models skill:

- Provides comprehensive selection guides for mainstream domestic and international open-source large language models (LLMs), including model comparisons, deployment options, and API usage.
- Covers major Chinese models (DeepSeek, Qwen, ChatGLM, Yi, MiniMax, Baichuan, Kimi) and global models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, Falcon, Granite, DBRX).
- Includes scenario-based and deployment-specific model recommendations.
- Offers ready-to-use API call templates for different providers and unified model routing strategies.
- Documents local deployment methods via Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp.
- Summarizes best practices for model selection, cost reduction, quality improvement, and model switching.
- Provides links to official resources and deployment tools.
